facts.fact: MTN Business launched a tier-3 data centre in Nairobi serving corporations, SMEs and the public sector, offering Microsoft Azure and Office 365 through its platform; the document gives no date beyond its published date, 2017-03-30.
MTN Business states its new Nairobi data centre is tier 3, citing the Uptime Institute definition but giving no Uptime certification; operator-stated, date taken from the published date 2017-03-30.
